features.title: Add MCP server for AI email tools
features.user_visible_behavior: A local stdio MCP server can safely expose read-oriented mailbox tools against an existing SupaMail database.
features.notes: Per ADR 0014, the MCP server is built in this core repo as a read-only surface; cloud only hosts it. Core owns the server implementation, the read-tool contract, and the local stdio binding; the remote transport, bearer/tenant auth, and MCP token secrets live in supamail-cloud. Build the server with an injected database connection and a transport boundary so the same tool logic runs locally (stdio) and hosted (remote-authed). Start local stdio first; remote transport must be absent from the public package. V1 is read-only.

features.title: Build an agent-first email CLI
features.user_visible_behavior: A local coding agent can inspect mirrored email through stable CLI commands with deterministic, machine-readable output and clear sync trust signals.
features.notes: Per ADR 0014, the agent CLI is built in this core repo as a read-only surface; cloud only hosts it (build location is not run location). Core owns the CLI commands and their deterministic, machine-readable output with clear sync-trust signals; cloud handles per-tenant routing and auth. Keep the first pass read-oriented against the existing mirror; sending, scheduling, contacts, calendar, CRM hydration, and AI summarization stay out of scope unless a later ADR explicitly adds them. This complements issue #4 MCP and should share the same read-tool contract.
